title: Governance Platform Hardening
objective: Make the governance platform itself deterministic, trustworthy, and self-consistent before allowing it to govern the repository.

phase_0.title: Governance Architecture Freeze
phase_0.purpose: Freeze the governance platform architecture before implementing WS1-WS9.

specification_drift_policy.policy: After Phase 0.75, no workstream may modify frozen architecture or specifications.
specification_drift_policy.process: If implementation reveals incorrect specification, implementation must stop. Change must be proposed through new ADR and specification update. Only after specification update may implementation continue.
specification_drift_policy.purpose: Prevent 'fixing the spec in code' and keep architecture as source of truth.

status_note: Not PENDING: substantial engineering (determinism, single-canonical-runtime, Evidence/Integrity/Freeze engines, reverse closure, validator exit semantics, identifier-normalization fix) is complete and live-verified. Not CERTIFIED: Phase-0-frozen specification is only partially implemented across all 9 workstreams -- see WORKSTREAM-STATUS-ROLLUP.json. See also phase_0.75/adr_0012_phase0_specification_revision_PROPOSED.md for a proposed (not yet ratified) path to resolve the specification-vs-implementation gap.
